Source-only product decision bd498fd4-8414-45f4-9067-2635fb3d4112 completed on existing origin/codex/smart-preview-ui54502c3d. Tests-first87bd828c; productiond5a59393. Absent UseSmartPreviews now defaults FALSE/Original through tested preference helper; explicit saved true/false values preserved, no read writes a preference. No silent source switch after native failure.

Valid clean or dirty offline preview now gets explicit Library → Smart Previews → Use Smart Preview guidance plus contextual menu action using the existing save/reopen path. Missing preview instead asks to reconnect original before building; stale/conflict/failed remain blocked. Prior status coalescing and thumbnail age disclosure preserved. Native API unchanged. SaveAs3ca3e9c9 preserved.

Combined suite now15 deterministic methods, all UNRUN on B. Only source inspection/git diff --check; no compile/build/app/test/benchmark/heartbeat/writer restart. A measurement motivates default but UI makes no speed/compression promise. Handoff with exact source map/remaining native, strict and GUI gates: tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/SMART-PREVIEW-SWIFT-HANDOFF.md on54502c3d; durable wp/B5-16 note updated. A owns runtime/main.
